// ShotSolver.java - on-robot flight solver, generated by BIOBUZZ Shot Sim. Plain Java 8, no dependencies (FTC SDK not needed).
// What it does: for a distance from the robot to the target it finds the ball exit speed (m/s) whose flight path passes the AIM point (a per-distance table),
// then converts it to motor rpm and encoder ticks per second. The flight model is the simulator's: quadratic drag + Magnus lift, RK4.
// Use:  ShotSolver solver = new ShotSolver();            (once)
//       ShotSolver.Result r = solver.solve(distanceIn);  (each shot; distanceIn = robot distance to the CELL mouth centre, inches)
//       if (r.ok) { flywheel.setVelocity(r.ticksPerSec); hood.setPosition(servoFor(r.thetaDeg)); }   // your own hood servo map
// Timing: solver.lastSolveNanos holds the duration of the last solve; send it to telemetry and check it on your Control Hub.
// Port check: java ShotSolver < vectors.csv   (one distance per line, first column used) prints the results for comparison with the simulator.
public final class ShotSolver {
    // ---- constants from the simulator (filled in by the export; do not edit by hand, re-export instead) ----
    static final double MASS_KG = {{MASS_KG}};           // ball mass
    static final double AREA_M2 = {{AREA_M2}};          // ball cross-section
    static final double RHO = {{RHO}};                  // air density, kg/m^3
    static final double CD = {{CD}};                    // drag coefficient
    static final double CL_SLOPE = {{CL_SLOPE}};        // lift coefficient per unit spin ratio
    static final double CL_SMAX = {{CL_SMAX}};          // spin ratio clamp (symmetric)
    static final double G = {{G}};                      // gravity, m/s^2
    static final double S0 = {{S0}};                    // spin ratio at launch (+1 backspin, -1 topspin, between for dual wheels)
    static final double DT = {{DT}};                    // RK4 step, s (same as the simulator)
    static final double H0_M = {{H0_M}};                // mouth height above the floor, m
    static final double AIM_Z_M = {{AIM_Z_M}};          // aim height used when the aim table is empty, m
    static final double[] AIM_D_IN = { {{AIM_D_IN}} };      // aim table: robot distance, inches (sorted)
    static final double[] AIM_Z = { {{AIM_Z}} };            // aim point: height of the recommended path above the mouth at that distance, m
    static final boolean HOOD_FIXED = {{HOOD_FIXED}};   // true: one fixed launch angle; false: angle table below
    static final double HOOD_ANGLE_DEG = {{HOOD_ANGLE_DEG}};
    static final double[] HOOD_D_IN = { {{HOOD_D_IN}} };    // robot distance, inches (sorted)
    static final double[] HOOD_DEG = { {{HOOD_DEG}} };      // launch angle at those distances, degrees
    static final double RPM_PER_MPS = {{RPM_PER_MPS}};  // motor rpm per m/s of exit speed (used when the per-rpm map below is empty)
    static final double[] RPM_MAP_V = { {{RPM_MAP_V}} };      // per-rpm calibration only: exit speed (m/s, ascending) ...
    static final double[] RPM_MAP_RPM = { {{RPM_MAP_RPM}} };  // ... and the motor rpm that gives it (piecewise linear between the nodes, end slope beyond them)
    static final double TICKS_PER_MOTOR_REV = {{TICKS_PER_MOTOR_REV}};
    static final double MOUTH_FORWARD_IN = {{MOUTH_FORWARD_IN}};   // robot distance minus mouth distance, inches

    // ---- solver limits (same as the JS reference) ----
    private static final double IN_M = 0.0254, DEG = Math.PI / 180;
    private static final double T_MAX = 2.6, V_LO = 2, V_HI = 16, V_STEP = 0.25, V_TOL = 1e-6;
    private static final int MAX_IT = 80;

    public static final class Result {
        public boolean ok;            // false: beyond reach (no speed below V_HI passes the aim point) or bad constants
        public double thetaDeg = Double.NaN, vMps = Double.NaN, motorRpm = Double.NaN, ticksPerSec = Double.NaN;
        public int iterations;        // flights simulated
    }

    public long lastSolveNanos;

    // linear interpolation in a table (xs sorted), flat beyond its ends; NaN for an empty table or a NaN distance
    private static double interp(double[] xs, double[] ys, double d) {
        int n = xs.length;
        if (n == 0 || Double.isNaN(d)) return Double.NaN;
        if (d <= xs[0]) return ys[0];
        if (d >= xs[n - 1]) return ys[n - 1];
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n - 1 && !(d < xs[i + 1])) i++;
        return ys[i] + (d - xs[i]) * (ys[i + 1] - ys[i]) / (xs[i + 1] - xs[i]);
    }

    /** Launch angle for a robot distance: fixed, or linear interpolation in the hood table. */
    static double angleFor(double d) {
        if (Double.isNaN(d)) return Double.NaN;
        return HOOD_FIXED ? HOOD_ANGLE_DEG : interp(HOOD_D_IN, HOOD_DEG, d);
    }

    /** Aim height (m above the mouth) for a robot distance: linear interpolation in the aim table. */
    static double aimFor(double d) { return AIM_D_IN.length == 0 ? AIM_Z_M : interp(AIM_D_IN, AIM_Z, d); }

    /** Motor rpm for an exit speed: piecewise-linear map when the calibration is per-rpm, else v * RPM_PER_MPS. */
    static double rpmFor(double v) {
        int n = RPM_MAP_V.length, i = 0;
        if (n < 2) return v * RPM_PER_MPS;
        if (v >= RPM_MAP_V[n - 1]) i = n - 2; else if (v > RPM_MAP_V[0]) while (i < n - 2 && v >= RPM_MAP_V[i + 1]) i++;
        return RPM_MAP_RPM[i] + (v - RPM_MAP_V[i]) * (RPM_MAP_RPM[i + 1] - RPM_MAP_RPM[i]) / (RPM_MAP_V[i + 1] - RPM_MAP_V[i]);
    }

    // acceleration of the ball at velocity (ux, uz): drag against the velocity, lift perpendicular to it
    private static void accel(double ux, double uz, double wr, double kd, double kl0, double[] out) {
        double v = Math.sqrt(ux * ux + uz * uz), sr = v > 1e-9 ? wr / v : 0;
        if (sr > CL_SMAX) sr = CL_SMAX; else if (sr < -CL_SMAX) sr = -CL_SMAX;
        double kl = kl0 * sr;
        out[0] = -kd * v * ux - kl * v * uz;
        out[1] = -G - kd * v * uz + kl * v * ux;
    }

    /** Height (m, above the mouth) where the path crosses horizontal distance rho; -Infinity if it never gets there. */
    private static double heightAt(double thetaDeg, double v0, double rho) {
        final double kd = 0.5 * RHO * CD * AREA_M2 / MASS_KG;
        final double kl0 = 0.5 * RHO * AREA_M2 / MASS_KG * CL_SLOPE;
        final double wr = S0 * v0, dt = DT;
        double th = thetaDeg * DEG, x = 0, z = 0, vx = v0 * Math.cos(th), vz = v0 * Math.sin(th);
        double[] a = new double[2];
        int n = (int) Math.round(T_MAX / dt);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double x0 = x, z0 = z;
            accel(vx, vz, wr, kd, kl0, a); double a1x = a[0], a1z = a[1];
            double b2x = vx + dt / 2 * a1x, b2z = vz + dt / 2 * a1z;
            accel(b2x, b2z, wr, kd, kl0, a); double a2x = a[0], a2z = a[1];
            double b3x = vx + dt / 2 * a2x, b3z = vz + dt / 2 * a2z;
            accel(b3x, b3z, wr, kd, kl0, a); double a3x = a[0], a3z = a[1];
            double b4x = vx + dt * a3x, b4z = vz + dt * a3z;
            accel(b4x, b4z, wr, kd, kl0, a); double a4x = a[0], a4z = a[1];
            x += dt / 6 * (vx + 2 * b2x + 2 * b3x + b4x);
            z += dt / 6 * (vz + 2 * b2z + 2 * b3z + b4z);
            vx += dt / 6 * (a1x + 2 * a2x + 2 * a3x + a4x);
            vz += dt / 6 * (a1z + 2 * a2z + 2 * a3z + a4z);
            if (x >= rho) { double f = (rho - x0) / (x - x0); return z0 + f * (z - z0); }
            if (z < -H0_M) return Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;   // hit the floor first
        }
        return Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    }

    private Result search(double dRobotIn) {
        Result r = new Result();
        double th = angleFor(dRobotIn), rho = (dRobotIn - MOUTH_FORWARD_IN) * IN_M, aim = aimFor(dRobotIn);
        r.thetaDeg = th;
        if (!(Double.isFinite(th) && Double.isFinite(rho) && rho > 0 && Double.isFinite(aim) && Double.isFinite(RPM_PER_MPS)
                && Double.isFinite(TICKS_PER_MOTOR_REV) && Double.isFinite(H0_M))) return r;
        double lo = V_LO, hi = lo, mid;
        int it = 1;
        if (!(heightAt(th, lo, rho) - aim < 0)) return r;
        // Scan up in V_STEP steps to the first speed that reaches the aim height (lowest root, rising branch), then bisect that bracket.
        boolean found = false;
        while (!found && hi < V_HI) {
            lo = hi; hi = Math.min(hi + V_STEP, V_HI);
            found = heightAt(th, hi, rho) - aim >= 0;
            it++;
        }
        if (!found) { r.iterations = it; return r; }
        while (hi - lo > V_TOL && it < MAX_IT) {
            mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (heightAt(th, mid, rho) - aim < 0) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
            it++;
        }
        r.iterations = it;
        r.ok = hi - lo <= V_TOL;
        if (!r.ok) return r;
        r.vMps = (lo + hi) / 2;
        r.motorRpm = rpmFor(r.vMps);
        r.ticksPerSec = r.motorRpm / 60 * TICKS_PER_MOTOR_REV;
        return r;
    }

    /** Exit speed, motor rpm and ticks/s for a robot distance in inches. Sets lastSolveNanos. */
    public Result solve(double dRobotIn) {
        long t0 = System.nanoTime();
        Result r = search(dRobotIn);
        lastSolveNanos = System.nanoTime() - t0;
        return r;
    }

    /** Port check: reads distances (first CSV column) from stdin, prints one result line per distance. */
    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.io.IOException {
        java.io.BufferedReader in = new java.io.BufferedReader(new java.io.InputStreamReader(System.in));
        ShotSolver s = new ShotSolver();
        System.out.println("dRobotIn,thetaDeg,vMps,motorRpm,ticksPerSec,ok,iterations,solveNanos");
        String line;
        while ((line = in.readLine()) != null) {
            line = line.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.charAt(0) == '#') continue;
            double d;
            try { d = Double.parseDouble(line.split(",")[0].trim()); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { continue; }
            Result r = s.solve(d);
            System.out.println(d + "," + r.thetaDeg + "," + r.vMps + "," + r.motorRpm + "," + r.ticksPerSec + "," + r.ok + "," + r.iterations + "," + s.lastSolveNanos);
        }
    }
}
